exposure: Fetal Doppler ultrasound findings (e.g., abnormal umbilical artery (UA) flow patterns, abnormal UA and middle cerebral artery (MCA) Doppler indices)
cohort: The study included 145 high-risk pregnant women, of whom 120 delivered at the institute.
finding: Abnormal umbilical artery and middle cerebral artery Doppler indices correlated significantly with adverse neonatal outcomes, including lower APGAR scores and higher NICU admission rates.
mod_finding: Most deliveries were via caesarean section (82.5%), and abnormal Doppler patterns were significantly associated with adverse neonatal outcomes, necessitating timely caesarean deliveries.
